customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Manage your custom fields and configurations

error.unauthorized: Please log in as an administrator

organizations.title: $t(terms.organization)
organizations.description: Balance, revenue, profit, listings and ad spend of every participating $t(terms.organization). Click a column heading to sort.
organizations.supplyMismatch: * The MP ledger does not add up

tradeAnalysis.title: Trading bias
tradeAnalysis.lead: Shows mutual buying and reliance on a single partner as numbers.
tradeAnalysis.notice: This is not a judgement of cheating.
tradeAnalysis.detail: Buying from a friend because the product is genuinely good and buying from each other to score points look the same in the data. If a pair looks odd, ask the $t(terms.participant) themselves.

mutual.title: Mutual trade rate
mutual.description: Trade between the two $t(terms.organization) / total trade of those two $t(terms.organization). Pairs above {{threshold}}% are highlighted. Two $t(terms.organization) that trade only with each other reach 50% (the same amount is counted twice in the total).

concentration.title: Purchase concentration
concentration.lead: Share of everything a $t(terms.organization) bought that went to its biggest supplier.
concentration.notice: A $t(terms.organization) that bought from only one supplier is always at 100%.
concentration.detail: $t(terms.organization) that simply bought very few times also rise to the top, so read the number of suppliers and the amount together.

purchaseLog.title: $t(terms.administrator) purchase log
purchaseLog.lead: What each $t(terms.administrator) bought and for how much is
purchaseLog.detail: It is here so that a $t(terms.administrator) can notice their own unintended bias. $t(terms.participant) cannot see this page.

bySeller.title: By $t(terms.organization) (bought by $t(terms.administrator))
bySeller.description: The number of $t(terms.administrator) is shown as well, so you can tell whether one $t(terms.administrator) bought a lot or many $t(terms.administrator) bought a little.

passwordReset.title: Password reset
passwordReset.lead: Use this when a $t(terms.participant) has lost their password.
passwordReset.notice: Check who they are in the classroom first.
passwordReset.detail: This system does not know which Market ID belongs to whom. The characters below are shown only once, so write them down and hand them over on the spot.

result.title: Issued
result.warning: Once you leave this screen you can never see these again.
result.next: After handing them over, ask them to change the password themselves.

error.notFound: No account has that Market ID ({{marketId}}). Please check for typing mistakes.

marketSettings.title: Settings
marketSettings.lead: Numbers you can change to fit your class.
marketSettings.notice: Saving takes effect for everyone straight away.
marketSettings.detail: To go back to the original numbers, press "Reset everything to the defaults" below.

initialFunds.label: Starting funds
initialFunds.help: Given once when a new $t(terms.organization) is created. Balances that already exist do not change.

loginMaxAttempts.label: Failed logins before locking
loginMaxAttempts.help: After this many failures in a row, logging in is blocked for a while.

loginLockMinutes.label: How long logging in stays blocked (minutes)
loginLockMinutes.help: While it is blocked, even the correct password will not work.

mutualTradeThreshold.label: Mutual trading rate to highlight (%)
mutualTradeThreshold.help: Pairs above this rate are coloured on the "Trading bias" screen.

quizzes.title: Quiz bonus table
quizzes.lead: How much is given for each score. Each quiz can have its own table.
quizzes.validDays: Days the bonus can be used

problem.empty: The table is empty. Add at least one row.
problem.notAList: That value cannot be used. Please enter numbers only.
problem.scoreOutOfRange: Scores must be whole numbers from 0 to 100 ({{value}}).
problem.amountNegative: Amounts must be whole numbers of 0 or more ({{value}}).
problem.missingZero: Please decide the amount for a score of 0.
problem.notMonotonic: A higher score gives less than a lower one.
